exec: Ministerial scrutiny of third-party cyber risk in a major airline's outsourcing plan signals rising political expectations on supplier security.
plain: Australia's transport minister says Qantas handing 850 office jobs to an outside firm could weaken control over customer data.
summary: Transport Minister Catherine King told ABC Radio National she is concerned Qantas may lose some control of its data by outsourcing 850 head-office jobs to Accenture, pointing to third-party weaknesses such as the attack on reservations provider Amadeus. She urged the airline to weigh reputational damage and to retrain or redeploy affected staff.
title: Australian transport minister voices cyber security concern over Qantas outsourcing to Accenture

validation.note: One outlet reporting the minister's radio remarks.

review.note: Compared King's ABC RN remarks, 850 jobs to Accenture, Amadeus, reputation, retrain/redeploy against Cyber Daily (published 13 Nov AEDT / 12 Nov UTC).
